newsitem.title: UK: LPC-Poland's Netia South gets $115 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Poland's Netia South gets $115 mln loan.

text.p: LONDON, October 31 (LPC) - Polish telecommunications company Netia South has mandated Chase Investment Bank and Warsaw-based Bank Handlowy to arrange a multi-currency $115 million term loan, the arrangers announced.
The two banks have fully underwritten the facility. Chase Investment Bank will act as bookrunner and documentation agent and Chase Manhattan Bank will be the facility agent.

In July, sister company Netia Telecom signed a $180 million ten-year loan. That credit was arranged by the EBRD and ABN AMRO Bank and was to finance construction of a 350,000 fixed line telephone network.
Netia South, through its majority owned subsidiary Telekom Silesia, will build, own and operate a fully-digital telecommunications network in Silesia.

Netia's main shareholder RP Telekom, with 65%, is made up a group of 240 Polish and foreign firms including Isreal's Danker Bank and Goldman Sachs Investment Bank. Sweden's Telia holds 25% and EBRD 10%.
